ShowAmount.rationale: presentation only: read solely by EnchantmentModel.DynamicExtraCardText (EnchantmentModel.cs:60-81) and the card-UI nodes; no game-state reader. Out of scope per the shared contract's 'presentation/animation' waiver.

CanEnchantCardType.maps_to: SharpEnchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:398-402) -- `card_type == CardType.ATTACK`, matching Sharp.cs:10-13. Enchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:51-61) + the subclass override. Base CanEnchant (EnchantmentModel.cs:273-294) rejects CardType 4/5/6 (Status/Curse/Quest), then CanEnchantCardType, then an Unplayable card whose pile is PileType.Deck, then a card that already has a (non-stackable) enchantment. The sim folds CanEnchantCardType into each subclass's own can_enchant and replaces the pile-qualified Unplayable test with an unconditional `not card.is_playable` -- equal in practice because every ported grant enchants a DECK card (probe `grants`).

EnchantDamageAdditive.maps_to: SharpEnchantment.modify_damage_additive (enchantments.py:404-408) -- returns `amount` for its own card, matching Sharp.cs:15-22's `base.Amount`; the `!props.IsPoweredAttack() -> 0m` guard is hoisted into the caller (cmds.py:56). The grant sets amount 2 (events/self_help_book.py:13). Additive-only, so BR-1's phase difference provably cannot bite -- this unit IS the executed control: Sharp(+2) with Strength(+3) on a base-6 Strike deals 11 in both engines (`py tools/audit/enchantment_probes.py order`).
